item_title: The Hacker News reports CISA added the WordPress Core race condition CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS 8.1) to KEV with a federal fix deadline of 6 November, and Wordfence counted more than 18,500 requests to staged installer paths in the first 21 hours after disclosure

bridge: A further UKMTO-reported projectile strike on a tanker, now off Qatar, keeps the shipping-attack rate near the October pace.
item_title: UKMTO reported that a tanker was hit by two projectiles about 50 nautical miles north of Madinat ash-Shamal, Qatar, at 2320 GMT on 4 November; the vessel was not identified and no one claimed the attack

bridge: Iranian mine claims lack independent confirmation and the counts differ, so they add colour and little weight.
item_title: The Guards and the Iranian army said at least five tankers and a tugboat caught fire after hitting mines east and south of the Strait of Hormuz on 5 November; Al Jazeera could not confirm the incidents and the counts differ between the two Iranian accounts

bridge: Pentagon readiness to resume major operations keeps the strike-package alternative open while the market prices de-escalation.
item_title: Al Jazeera, relaying The New York Times, reports unnamed Pentagon officials and commanders saying US forces are poised to resume major combat operations against Iran on Trump's order; the article confirms no decision

bridge: Another overnight raid with outages in seven regions including Kyiv, two days after the 3 November raid.
item_title: Ukraine's General Staff said it shot down or jammed 196 Russian drones overnight into 6 November, with impacts or debris at 22 locations, and the Moscow Times reports outages across seven regions including Kyiv and Kharkiv, with the capital region's grid partly shut after heavy damage

bridge: A Ukrainian drone attack that set fire to the Afipsky refinery shows the reciprocal pattern continuing, though both sides' figures are party claims.
item_title: Russia's Defence Ministry said it intercepted 142 Ukrainian drones over Russia and Crimea overnight into 6 November; Krasnodar authorities reported a fire at an industrial site in Afipsky, which Astra identified as the Afipsky oil refinery, about 3% of Russian refining capacity

bridge: ISW geolocation corroborates the Afipsky fire and counts 227 Russian drones, which fits the reciprocal energy-strike pattern.
item_title: ISW assessed that Russia launched 227 drones, 86 of them jet-powered, at Ukraine overnight into 6 November, with Ukrenergo reporting new outages, and that geolocated footage shows a smoke plume at the Afipsky refinery, at least the sixth Ukrainian strike on it in 2026

bridge: A fatal attack on a tanker and a further claimed mine strike show shipping attacks continuing while the strait stays closed; both are unconfirmed by a maritime authority.
item_title: gCaptain reported one seafarer killed in a suspected missile attack on the Marshall Islands-flagged tanker Velos Sapphire, sailing unladen toward Bahrain, as relayed in the Straits Live daily brief, headline

bridge: If accurate, the Iranian claim of two mine-struck tankers on an "unauthorised route" would show the closure enforced through deniable means; it is a party claim, and INTERTANKO found no credible evidence for earlier mine claims.
item_title: Iran's military said two tankers caught fire after hitting mines on an "unauthorised route" through the strait; ABC reports no independent confirmation

bridge: US interdiction of a blockade runner in the Gulf of Oman shows both sides contesting transit, which keeps unescorted passage unlikely.
item_title: US Central Command said one of its aircraft disabled a St Kitts-flagged ship in the Gulf of Oman after it ignored warnings and tried to leave the region after visiting an Iranian port

bridge: Qatari proposals under Iranian review keep a bargain possible, but Tehran ties any talks to prior US concessions and no transit deal is announced.
item_title: The Associated Press reports Iran is reviewing Qatari proposals on its nuclear programme and Trump spoke with Qatar's emir on 6 November; an Iranian official said Tehran will not negotiate its atomic activities until the US meets several conditions

bridge: A 172-drone and 36-ballistic-missile raid with a hit on a substation serving two nuclear plants keeps the Russian energy campaign at winter-grade intensity.
item_title: ISW counted 172 Russian drones, 137 of them jet-powered, in the overnight raid into 7 November; Zelensky said Russia fired 36 ballistic missiles at Kyiv city and oblast and that a substation linking the Rivne and Khmelnytskyi nuclear plants to Kyiv was damaged

bridge: A repeat Ukrainian strike on the Saratov refinery shows the reciprocal pattern holding.
item_title: ISW describes the Ukrainian strike on the Saratov oil refinery on the night of 6 to 7 November as at least the eighth against it in 2026, citing Russian and Ukrainian reporting

bridge: Abu Dhabi talks on 10-11 November are scheduled, but Moscow's rejection of foreign deployment and silence on energy limits leave no truce in sight.
item_title: Trilateral talks are scheduled for 10 and 11 November in Abu Dhabi; Russian foreign ministry spokeswoman Zakharova called any foreign deployment to Ukraine "categorically unacceptable" and said Europeans have no place at the talks

bridge: SonicWall's report of potential exploitation and CISA's same-week KEV listing show exploitation signals reaching defenders before a patch cycle can absorb them.
item_title: SonicWall disclosed CVE-2026-19868, an SSL-VPN authentication bypass (CVSS 7.1) in SonicOS configurations using SAML that can defeat SAML-enforced MFA, and said its PSIRT investigated a report of potential exploitation; CISA listed it in KEV with a 20 November federal deadline; fixed in 7.3.4-7013 and 8.2.3-8015, no workaround

bridge: Exploitation of the Plex2Shell chain followed publication of technical details on 16 October within days and reached KEV on 20 October.
item_title: QNAP said it has multiple reports of NAS devices compromised through the Plex2Shell chain (CVE-2026-96652, -96654, -96655, -96656) in Plex Media Server, exploited after technical details appeared on 16 October and listed in KEV on 20 October; it advises treating exposed devices as compromised and updating to Plex 1.43.3.10861

bridge: An estimated theft of up to EUR 118 million (the bank validates only the order of magnitude) through a service provider's platform shows a third-party route to bank funds; the bank says customer assets were unaffected.
item_title: On 4 November Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirmed a sophisticated attack, with withdrawals the day before reports emerged on 2 November, in which an attacker reached its network through a service provider's platform and moved funds from the bank's own account; ZachXBT estimated up to EUR 118 million (about $133 million) in USDC and USDT, a figure the bank said it can validate only as an order of magnitude; no actor is named

bridge: An APT29 smartphone campaign across Ukraine, the US and Europe adds espionage alongside the physical sabotage campaign; it does not by itself show disruption.
item_title: Sekoia attributes to APT29 a campaign using patched iOS and Android browser flaws and the DarkSword toolkit against devices in Ukraine, the US and Europe, delivered through compromised sites and a Ukrainian analytics script (Plerdy); the targets included a Ukrainian gas producer and a US chemical trade association

bridge: Iranian state TV reported projectiles from Sirik and explosions on Qeshm on 9 November, cause unconfirmed; the pattern fits continued low-level, deniable fire.
item_title: Iranian state TV reported three projectiles launched from Sirik toward the Strait of Hormuz and explosions were heard on Qeshm Island; the causes remain unconfirmed.

bridge: The White House and the IRGC restated opposed positions on blockade enforcement, which keeps the conditions for reopening unmet.
item_title: The White House said Task Force Iron Gate is operating with full force and effect, Trump said very little gets into or out of Iran, and the IRGC dismissed the expanded blockade as a play on words.

bridge: Mediators stopped travelling after the midterms and Rubio said no breakthrough is near, which lowers the near-term chance of a sequenced reopening.
item_title: Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi said mediators stopped travelling after the US midterms, Secretary of State Rubio said the sides are not on the verge of a breakthrough, and Trump said renewed strikes are highly unlikely if talks progress.

bridge: A raid on 7 November hit energy sites around Kyiv and lines from two nuclear plants, showing Russian strikes on energy continue.
item_title: Reuters reported that Russia's overnight raid on 7 November hit energy sites around Kyiv, seriously damaged lines carrying power from two nuclear plants and damaged the Northern Bridge over the Dnipro, killing at least two and wounding about a dozen, with Zelenskiy saying only four of 36 ballistic missiles were intercepted

bridge: ISW counts outages in six oblasts, power restrictions in Kyiv City and about 600,000 people without power around Dnipro on 8 November.
item_title: ISW cites the Ukrainian Air Force for 164 Russian strike drones (112 jet-powered) and three cruise missiles overnight into 8 November, with outages in six oblasts and power restrictions in Kyiv City and about 600,000 people without power in Dnipro city and Dnipropetrovsk Oblast

bridge: A 317-drone raid overnight into 9 November extends the campaign; the Russian claim of four substations struck is a party claim.
item_title: AP reports Ukraine's air force counted 317 Russian drones overnight into 9 November, 105 of them jet-powered, while Russia's Defence Ministry said it struck four electrical substations in the Kyiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Cherkasy and Vinnytsia regions; the Russian figure is a party claim

bridge: The Leningrad governor says Ukrainian drones started a fire at the Kirishi refinery; a party claim that fits the reciprocal strike pattern.
item_title: Leningrad governor Drozdenko said Ukrainian drones started a fire at the KINEF refinery at Kirishi, which AP places more than 1,200 km from the border

bridge: Trump and Zelenskyy speak of progress before the Abu Dhabi talks, but both statements are party claims and AP notes Geneva produced no significant progress.
item_title: Zelenskyy said the EU agreed a fund to speed grid repairs, and Trump told "60 Minutes" the sides are "very close" to a deal ahead of the Abu Dhabi talks starting Tuesday; AP notes Geneva in February produced no significant progress

bridge: Pyongyang denies the FBI attribution; the denial carries no weight against the technical attribution.
item_title: Kim Yo Jong called the FBI's Binance attribution absurd rhetoric and a grave political provocation, denied North Korean involvement and ended with 'issues to reconsider' without naming countermeasures

bridge: Elliptic traced laundering across about 12,000 wallets on 11 blockchains in four days, with about 56% of the proceeds not yet frozen.
item_title: Elliptic traced about 12,000 wallets across 11 blockchains and more than 40,000 transactions in the first four days of Binance laundering, put the theft at $6.43 billion, and said about $2.85 billion (44%) is frozen or seized with $3.24 billion still in linked addresses

bridge: Internet-exposed OT controllers drew a joint US advisory; it extends the exposure argument beyond classic edge appliances.
item_title: CISA, FBI, HHS, USDA and DOT warn that actors are targeting internet-exposed industrial refrigeration and cold-chain controllers worldwide; The Hacker News reports hundreds of supermarkets in 12 European countries hit, setpoints raised to as high as 50C, three French Blood Establishment plasma storage sites affected through a refrigeration provider, and no attribution; Censys saw Danfoss StoreView exposure fall from 3,004 to 708 instances between 9 October and 5 November

bridge: Exploitation of OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158 began under nine hours after the CVE was published.
item_title: The Hacker News reports, in an update of 8 November, exploitation of OpenSSH 'SSHole' (CVE-2026-123158, CVSS 8.1) on musl-based Linux such as Alpine with PAM disabled: Previdian saw the first attempt under nine hours after the CVE was published and root on a honeypot, and 20 attempts from 13 IPs by 8 November; fixed in OpenSSH 10.6p2; no KEV listing is mentioned

bridge: Lumen confirms Volt Typhoon exploited at least four zero-days against edge and management systems.
item_title: BleepingComputer, summarizing Lumen Black Lotus Labs, reports Volt Typhoon used the Silent Train rotating relay network, with sessions under 8 hours and four zero-days against edge and management systems (VeloCloud Orchestrator CVE-2026-16812, Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN CVE-2026-20127, N-able N-central CVE-2025-8875/-8876, Versa Director CVE-2024-39717) plus a suspected Quest KACE zero-day

bridge: Anonymous officials suspect Iran-linked actors in military freezer disruptions; attribution is unconfirmed and subject to change.
item_title: Defense One, citing two anonymous sources, reports US officials suspect Iran-linked hackers of disrupting freezers at about six military commissaries since late August, with US Cyber Command and DoD law enforcement investigating and French authorities assisting; attribution is described as subject to change

bridge: Refrigeration tampering across several EU countries has no attributed actor and the Kremlin denies involvement, so it is a watch item here.
item_title: CNBC reports that authorities have not identified who is behind the refrigeration tampering at Ahold Delhaize, IKEA, Colruyt and Carrefour sites in Belgium, Luxembourg, Sweden and the Netherlands, that the Kremlin called suggestions of Russian involvement baseless, and that analysts split between a state actor and boundary testing

bridge: C3RB3R ransomware hits outdated Synology NAS devices; relevant to extortion exposure on unpatched storage.
item_title: The Hacker News reports Synology warned of C3RB3R ransomware (.L0CK3D extension) hitting NAS devices on outdated DSM; Synology points to its November 2024 advisory (CVE-2024-10441 and two others) while Qihoo 360 cites two DSM flaws fixed in September 2026, CVE-2026-13684 and CVE-2026-13639

bridge: A 3AM affiliate used Veeam credential theft and backdoor domain admin accounts to encrypt 37 of nearly 50 machines.
item_title: Bitdefender reports a 3AM ransomware affiliate encrypted 37 of nearly 50 machines at a UK school estate in 10-19 September, using Veeam credential theft, two backdoor domain admin accounts and domain trusts, and suspects an AI-driven agentic loop based on commands repeated every 40 to 100 seconds

bridge: Check Point lists 13 HYFLOCK victims and Kaspersky saw an extortion-only PAYLOAD attack; both add to the extortion picture.
item_title: The Hacker News ThreatsDay reports Kaspersky saw an extortion-only PAYLOAD attack on a Middle Eastern manufacturer via a malicious Group Policy Object, and Check Point found HYFLOCK encrypts only the first 4,096 bytes of some files and lists 13 victims

bridge: Taiwan reports China Coast Guard jurisdiction broadcasts off its east coast.
item_title: Taiwan's CGA said China Coast Guard ships Hushi (1308) and Meishan (2303) are harassing shipping off Taiwan's east coast with radio broadcasts asserting jurisdiction, with regular patrols there since June

bridge: Taiwan detected 49 PLA aircraft and 6 warships in 24 hours, which an analyst called a quiet exercise.
item_title: Taiwan MND detected 49 PLA aircraft, 6 warships and 6 government vessels in the 24 hours to 06:00, which analyst Su Tzu-yun called a 'quiet exercise' without announced drills

bridge: The AFP count of Chinese vessels in the West Philippine Sea fell from 101 in September to 80 in October.
item_title: The AFP counted 80 Chinese naval and coast guard vessels at four West Philippine Sea features in October (33 PLAN, 47 CCG; 41 at Bajo de Masinloc, 24 at Ayungin), down from 101 in September

argument_text: Iran-linked actors are already operating against US infrastructure
bridge: France's attribution to an IRGC-linked group extends Iranian-linked operations to retail OT in Europe.
item_title: France attributes the October attacks on Danfoss refrigeration controllers, about 700 retail sites and at least 15 fires, to IRGC-linked Shahid Kaveh.

argument_text: Attacks continue at a low, deniable rate
bridge: The IRGC claims three tankers struck for using unauthorised routes; the report cites no outside confirmation.
item_title: The IRGC said it struck three tankers for using unauthorised routes in coordination with the US military, and a tanker was reported on fire near Hormuz; the report cites no outside confirmation.

argument_text: Iran conditions reopening on US concessions
bridge: Brent at $91.56 and Trump's remark that new strikes are quite unlikely point toward de-escalation.
item_title: Brent fell over 1% to $91.56 near 10-week lows on 10 November, and Trump said after meeting Qatar's prime minister that new strikes were quite unlikely and the war could end fairly soon.

argument_text: A bargain could reopen the strait
bridge: Araghchi's reopening sequence and Rubio's no-progress statement leave the closure unresolved.
item_title: Araghchi outlined a sequence in which the US acts on day one and Hormuz reopens on day two, while Rubio said talks have made no progress and called Iran's demands unrealistic.

argument_text: Exploitation now follows disclosure within days
bridge: GreyNoise logged the first successful in-the-wild exploitation of the OpenSSH SSHole bypass.
item_title: GreyNoise logged the first successful in-the-wild exploitation of the OpenSSH SSHole bypass (CVE-2026-123158) on 7 November, 16 chains from six IPs.

argument_text: Exploitation now follows disclosure within days
bridge: Barracuda says two flaws in its Email Security Gateway are exploited against a small number of appliances.
item_title: Barracuda says CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 in its Email Security Gateway are exploited against a small number of organisations.

argument_text: Exploitation now follows disclosure within days
bridge: QNAP reports NAS compromises through the Plex2Shell chain.
item_title: QNAP reports user compromises of NAS devices through the four-flaw Plex2Shell chain in Plex Media Server.

argument_text: Theft continues at scale
bridge: Elliptic shows TraderTraitor laundering Binance proceeds through memecoins.
item_title: The Independent reports Elliptic's 9 November analysis that TraderTraitor is minting novelty memecoins to obscure the $6.3bn Binance proceeds, about $430,000 of which has passed through them so far.

argument_text: European services see an escalating campaign
bridge: Estonia's interior minister characterises Russian acts in Europe as state terrorism.
item_title: Estonian Interior Minister Igor Taro told the Financial Times Russian acts in Europe should be called state terrorism, linking the August Milrem Robotics arson to Russia-recruited suspects.

argument_text: European services see an escalating campaign
bridge: Hoax threats disrupted flights, with no government attribution to Russia.
item_title: Hoax bomb threats disrupted more than two dozen European flights on Thursday and prompted fighter escorts, with no government formally naming a culprit for the threats, Reuters reports.

argument_text: Attacks are physical and attributed
bridge: NoName057(16) published personal data on 18 European officials, police and journalists.
item_title: NoName057(16) published personal data on 18 European officials, police and journalists and offered crypto rewards for more.

argument_text: Strikes have resumed on both sides
bridge: Strikes on 8 and 9 November left more than 600,000 without power in Dnipropetrovsk region.
item_title: Overnight Russian and Ukrainian strikes on 8-9 November left more than 600,000 without power in Dnipropetrovsk region and about 250,000 customers in Kharkiv, per DTEK and local figures relayed by SANA.

bridge: Six large substations in four central regions were hit overnight into 11 November, per Ukraine's prime minister, while talks ran in Abu Dhabi.
item_title: Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 163 drones overnight into 11 November, 91 of them jet-powered, plus missiles, with impacts at 17 locations, and Prime Minister Koretskyi said six large substations were hit in Vinnytsia, Kirovohrad, Zhytomyr and Cherkasy (Ukrainian official claims).

bridge: Russian officials report a Ukrainian strike on the Ust-Luga export hub, which would keep the reciprocal pattern running.
item_title: Leningrad governor Drozdenko said several Ukrainian drones hit the Ust-Luga port area on the Baltic, starting a fire and injuring three workers, and Russia's Defence Ministry said it destroyed 627 Ukrainian drones overnight (Russian official claims; RFE/RL calls Ust-Luga Russia's largest Baltic energy and oil export hub).

bridge: Reports of the talks mention a prisoner-exchange understanding and no energy truce, so the pause the alternative needs is not in evidence.
item_title: Russian delegation head Medinsky said the two-day Abu Dhabi talks reached an agreement in principle on a new large-scale prisoner exchange, and RFE/RL reports that Witkoff and Kushner are due to meet Putin in Moscow on 12 November; no energy truce is mentioned (party claim).

bridge: Both sides call the first day constructive without naming an energy pause; the statements are party claims.
item_title: Zelenskyy called the first day of the Abu Dhabi talks "constructive and quite substantive", covering humanitarian steps, prisoner exchanges, de-escalation and security guarantees, while Kushner called the meetings a "positive step" and Peskov said Moscow would give no details before the delegation briefed Putin (party statements).

bridge: Eurasia Group halving its odds of all-out hostilities points to lower US strike risk; blockade and attack sequencing, which decide reopening, remain unresolved.
item_title: Bloomberg copy reports Eurasia Group cut its odds of renewed all-out US-Iran hostilities to 30% from 60% after Trump said further strikes were not necessary; Brent fell 1.6% in early trading to $91.10 (its lowest closing level since August), Tehran wants the US blockade lifted before talks and Washington presses Iran to stop attacking shipping immediately.

bridge: An Outlook zero-day exploited before the patch shipped fits the exploit-before-patch pattern; it is a client flaw, outside the edge-device category.
item_title: Microsoft's November Patch Tuesday fixed 1,235 flaws by BleepingComputer's count, including an Outlook spoofing zero-day, CVE-2026-124194, that Microsoft says is exploited: a crafted message file makes Outlook connect to an attacker-controlled location without the external-content warning and can expose NTLM hashes.

bridge: A flaw Cisco patched in August entered KEV in November on evidence of exploitation.
item_title: CISA added Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, an unauthenticated XXE flaw in the OCI-P XML parser patched in August, to the KEV catalog on 10 November with a federal deadline of 24 November.

bridge: Xen Orchestra authentication bypass exploited in the wild with fixes already shipped.
item_title: Vates confirmed exploitation of an authentication bypass in Xen Orchestra (advisory VSA-2026-062, no CVE yet) in which a crafted authenticationToken cookie holding an empty JSON object grants admin access; fixes ship in 6.9.1, 6.10.0 and xo-server 5.211.2 and 5.213.1.

bridge: N-able patched the most critical disclosed flaws and the exposed population fell from 1,338 to about 148 servers in a day.
item_title: N-able released N-central 2026.4 HF2 fixing some of seven disclosed CVEs, including the most critical, after uncoordinated researcher disclosures on 8 November, and says all hosted servers are upgraded; Shadowserver counted about 148 exposed N-central servers, down from 1,338 a day earlier, and Defused saw probing, though N-able has not flagged exploitation.

bridge: A Chinese-speaking actor, per Malbear alone, extracted keys and records from a European telecom provider through a BroadWorks flaw.
item_title: Malbear Labs reports a Chinese-speaking actor used an autonomous framework built on a jailbroken DeepSeek Flash model to exploit Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 against a European telecom provider and 13 organisations on its infrastructure; the attribution and the AI tooling come from Malbear alone.

bridge: Check Point ties telecom and government intrusion sets to a shared tooling developer, and ESET maps DarkWire to FamousSparrow, which overlaps Salt Typhoon to some degree.
item_title: Check Point Research links three China-nexus espionage clusters (SilentDelivery, OceanGate, DarkWire) to a shared Sparrow malware ecosystem built by a developer it codenames CopperDragon, serving five actors including FamousSparrow and Earth Estries; targets include telecom, government and military bodies in Latin America, Asia and Europe.

bridge: Outages in nine regions after a further overnight raid keep the reciprocal pattern running; the counts are Ukrainian official claims.
item_title: Ukraine's Deputy Energy Minister Nekrasov said overnight Russian strikes caused power outages in nine regions, Kyiv's mayor said a drone hit a residential block and killed one woman, and the military said it shot down 89 of 123 Russian combat drones (Ukrainian official claims).

bridge: Ukraine says it has hit the five largest Russian refineries since 30 October, which sustains the reciprocal energy-strike pattern; a General Staff claim.
item_title: Ukraine's General Staff said it has struck Russia's five largest oil refineries since 30 October (Omsk, Kirishi, Ryazan, Nizhny Novgorod and Yaroslavl) as well as the smaller Novokuibyshevsk and Saratov plants (party claim).

bridge: The Kremlin meeting followed talks with no breakthrough and no energy pause is reported, so the alternative of a truce stays unsupported.
item_title: Al Jazeera reports that Kushner and Witkoff were meeting Putin in the Kremlin on 12 November after two days of US-mediated Abu Dhabi talks ended without a breakthrough; the US said differences remain on territory with some progress on post-war security guarantees, and a further prisoner exchange is planned.

bridge: Ghalibaf rules out a return to pre-war status and ties talks to lifting the blockade, a party position that leaves the closure in place.
item_title: Iran's parliament speaker and chief negotiator Ghalibaf told Al Jazeera that Hormuz will not return to its pre-war status, that Iran and Oman agreed to oversee it, and that Tehran awaits a US reply, through a Qatari mediator, to seven conditions that include lifting the US naval blockade (party claims).

bridge: IMO counts of 130 verified attacks and 25 seafarer deaths, including a Hormuz tanker attack on 5 November, show the shipping threat persists despite lower oil prices.
item_title: Cyprus Mail reports that the IMO has verified at least 130 attacks on commercial vessels in the region and at least 25 seafarer deaths since the conflict began, the latest after an attack on the tanker M/T VELOS SAPPHIRE in the Strait of Hormuz on 5 November, and that the IMO Council condemned Houthi attacks in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab Strait.
